lines: Tu koi ret pe likhi hui tehreer nahin
couplets.en: You are no words traced in sand.

lines: Waqt ke saath jo mit jaaye, tu woh tehreer nahin
couplets.en: You are no inscription that time can erase.

lines: Main teri yaad ko is dil se bhulata kaise
couplets.en: How could I ever put you out of my heart?

lines: Door reh kar dil mera shaad nahin ho sakta
couplets.en: Far from you, my heart cannot be glad.

lines: Yaad se laakh tujhe mujh se churane waale
couplets.en: Try as you might to steal yourself from my memory.

lines: Main teri yaad se azaad nahin ho sakta
couplets.en: I cannot be free of your memory.

lines: Dil hai, jaan hai tu, tooti hui zanjeer nahin
couplets.en: You are my heart and my life, no chain fallen apart.

lines: Dil hai seene mein dhadakta hua patthar to nahin
couplets.en: There is a beating heart in my chest, no stone.

lines: Yeh khayalon ki tapish se bhi pighal jaata hai
couplets.en: Even the warmth of a thought can melt it.

lines: Jab tasavvur mein kabhi saamne tu aa jaaye

lines: Dil mera milne ko tab aur machal jaata hai
couplets.en: Then my heart longs all the more to see you.

lines: Yaad phir yaad hai, tooti hui zanjeer nahin

lines: Tujhe kaise kahoon ke jo na paaunga tujhe

lines: Zindagi hai to mohabbat ke shabistaanon mein
couplets.en: If I live, in the quiet chambers of love.

lines: Apne har khwaab ki taabeer bana doonga tujhe

lines: Maan bhi jaao ke is khwaab ki taabeer nahin
